name: TokenRule
signature: public delegate bool TokenRule<TKind>(ref Tokenizer<TKind> tokenizer, out Token<TKind> token) where TKind : unmanaged, Enum

docs.summary: A structural token rule. Invoked when no fixed token matched at the current position. The rule should either consume characters and produce a token (returning `true`), or leave the tokenizer untouched and return `false`.
